question: What title did Mughal Emperor Jahangir bestow upon Captain William Hawkins during his residency at the imperial court in Agra?
explanation: Emperor Jahangir was highly pleased with Captain Hawkins' ability to speak the Turkish language and granted him the title of 'English Khan' (Inglis Khan), admitting him to the Mughal nobility.

question: Whom did Captain William Hawkins marry under the arrangement of Emperor Jahangir during his mission in Agra?
options: Mariam Khan, an Armenian Christian lady
A daughter of a Rajput chieftain
A sister of the Mughal governor of Surat
explanation: To tie Hawkins to the Mughal court, Emperor Jahangir arranged for him to marry Mariam Khan, the daughter of Mubarek Shah, an Armenian Christian merchant who had served Akbar.
